blocks.x: A working definition of Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture for the enterprise: engineered controls, named owners, weekly evidence, and a signed baseline so every claim of improvement can be replayed line by line.

The part that survives audit is the boring part: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy on Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering programs, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence. The design principle here is simple: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline for the enterprise at scale, so a regression is a cohort, never an estate.
